p: the LORD will have mercy on: He shows why God will haste to destroy his enemies, that is, because he will deliver his Church.
shall be joined with them: Meaning that the Gentiles will be joined with the Church and worship God.

servants and handmaids: Signifying that the Jews would be superior to the Gentiles and that they would be brought under the service of Christ by the preaching of the Apostles, by which all are brought to the subjection of Christ, 2Co 10:5.
none hindereth: That is, he permitted all violence and injuries to be done.
rest: Meaning that where tyrants reign, there can be no rest or quietness and also how detestable a thing tyranny is, seeing the insensible creatures have opportunity to rejoice at their destruction.

meet thee at thy coming: As though they feared, lest you should trouble the dead, as you did the living and here he derides the proud tyranny of the wicked, who know not that all creatures wish their destruction, that they may rejoice.
is spread under thee: Instead of your costly carpets and coverings.
Lucifer: You who thought yourself most glorious and as it were placed in the heaven for the morning star that goes before the sun, is called Lucifer, to whom Nebuchadnezzar is compared.
north: Meaning, Jerusalem of which the temple was of the north side, Ps 48:2.
look upon thee: In marvelling at you.
the house of his prisoners: To set them free, noting his cruelty.
cast out of thy grave like: You were not buried in the sepulchre of your fathers, your tyranny was so abhorred.
Prepare slaughter for his children for: He called to the Medes and Persians, and all those who would execute God's vengeance.
That I will break the Assyrian: As I have begun to destroy the Assyrians in Sennacherib: so will I continue and destroy them wholly, when I will deliver you from Babylon.
them: From the Jews.
burden: Read Geneva "Isa 13:1"
Palestina: He wills the Philistines not to rejoice because the Jews are diminished in their power, for their strength will be greater than it ever was.
firstborn of the poor shall feed: The Israelites who were brought to most extreme misery.
he shall slay thy remnant: That is, my people.
north a smoke: That is, from the Jews or Assyrians: for they were brought to extreme misery.
messengers of the nation: Who will come to enquire of the state of the Church.
Zion: They will answer that the Lord defends his Church and those that join themselves to it.
